name: ucrams
description: University Course Registration & Academic Management System

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ucrams/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ucrams/shared" "npm run dev -w @ucrams/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @ucrams/api" "npm run dev -w @ucrams/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ucrams/shared && npm run build -w @ucrams/api && npm run build -w @ucrams/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ucrams/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ucrams/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
